title: Playback Compatibility Matrix Hardening
problem: Playback planner compatibility interactions for container, codec, HDR, audio channel, downmix, and normalization behavior are covered by focused tests but not concentrated in a playback-only decision matrix.
gates: cargo nextest run -p nako-playback hdr audio --no-fail-fast

evidence.summary: Opened a playback-only compatibility matrix lane that can run beside HDR HTP-030 without touching transcode, server, Public Client API, or web/player behavior.

Added playback-only table-driven matrix tests for Direct Play, Remux, HLS Transcode, HDR tone-map-required remux denial, audio downmix, normalization, and selected HLS output shape without changing transcode, server, API DTOs, or player behavior.

Accepted planner review and fresh verification evidence, merged the playback-only compatibility matrix into main, closed the lane, and split full device profile, transcode/server/API, and player behavior expansion as follow-ons.

continue_policy.notes: Workstream complete. Open follow-on lanes for full device profile matrices, Public Client API reporting, transcode/server compatibility matrices, persisted preferences, or player behavior.
